title: The yellow umbrella
original:
It rained all the way home. I left my yellow umbrella beside the door, dripping onto the floorboards. The apartment was quiet for once.

I made tea in the chipped blue cup and finally finished that book. Around midnight, I heard three soft knocks from the kitchen. Probably the pipes.

I should get some sleep. I live alone, after all.

edits.text: Someone else was reading the same page.

title: A second cup
original:
The yellow umbrella was dry this morning. Strange, because there was a little puddle beneath it.

I found two cups on the kitchen table. Mine was still warm. I put the other one back in the cupboard. Perhaps I was more tired than I thought.

The knocking started again tonight. Three times. Always three.

edits.text: Someone else always answers the door.

title: A note to myself
original:
I moved the yellow umbrella into the closet. I checked the lock twice before bed.

There is a line in yesterday’s diary that I cannot remember writing. The ink looks different. I have been staring at it for twenty minutes.

If this happens again, I will leave this notebook open on the kitchen table. I want to see what happens when I stop looking.
